standards.name: IS 1239 (Part 1)
standards.description: Bureau of Indian Standards - mild steel / galvanized-iron tubes for water, gas, air and steam. Nominal bore 15-150 mm; three wall-thickness classes (Light/A, Medium/B, Heavy/C) sharing the same OD per NB. Governing standard.

standards.name: IS 1239 (Part 2)
standards.description: BIS - mild steel tubulars and other wrought steel pipe fittings (the fittings companion to Part 1's tubes). Governing standard.

standards.name: BS 1387:1985 / EN 10255:2004
standards.description: British/European standard for non-alloy steel tubes suitable for welding and threading; IS 1239 Part 1:2004 is stated equivalent. Governing standard.

GI.canonical_term: Galvanized Iron - zinc-coated mild steel tube (Material)

NB.canonical_term: Nominal Bore - the pipe's nominal internal size designation in mm (Nominal Diameter)

Class C.canonical_term: IS 1239 Heavy wall-thickness class (Class A=Light, B=Medium, C=Heavy; same OD, increasing wall)

industry_references.name: Sachiya Steel GI pipe size & weight chart (IS 1239 Class A/B/C) (manufacturer)
industry_references.description: Manufacturer dimension/weight chart: NB, OD, wall thickness and mass per metre for Classes A/B/C. Manufacturer spec, not a governing standard.

industry_references.name: Nezone Group GI pipes technical specifications (manufacturer)
industry_references.description: Manufacturer technical specification for galvanized iron pipes. Manufacturer spec, not a governing standard.
